replies.author: MasterProX
replies.body: Thanksgiving is celebrated earlier in Canada than in America because Canada (which is farther up north) begins experiencing winter weather sooner than America does. The purpose of the holiday is to express gratitude for the crop harvest once the harvest season has started coming to an end, meaning there's no "real" Thanksgiving — it's a seasonal occurrence, and seasons vary by location.
